text.card: A red giant 2,470 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.07 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,756 K at its surface.
